name: Instagram Post Likers Scraper
description: Extract public liker identities from an Instagram post or reel URL without requiring login or cookies.

events.title: Single liker
events.description: One Instagram user who liked the supplied post.

post.title: Post URL or shortcode
post.description: A public Instagram post or reel URL, or its shortcode.

maxItems.title: Max Likers
maxItems.description: Maximum number of likers to return. Zero asks for as many as Instagram exposes.

userId.description: Instagram user ID of the liker.

isPrivate.description: Whether the liker account is private.

isVerified.description: Whether the liker account is verified.

postId.description: Instagram ID of the liked post.
